thread:
zoe: tiny experiment: what's one TV opening OR single track that makes you feel like the kitchen is a concert hall? i'm curating a 'kitchen symphony' for the break room. :musical_keyboard:
alan: opening theme pick: 'Chef's Table' main theme. immediate haute cuisine vibes while chopping onions. :clap:
rhett: single track: 'Baba O'Riley' that opening synth feels like drying plates with purpose. :guitar:
mina: oblique pick: the intro to 'The Crown' it makes me bow to the espresso machine. dramatic and polite. :crown:
zoe: love the range. can we get one book/short-film pairing per pick? small ritual idea.
alan: Chef's Table theme -> watch 9-min short 'A Day in a Bakery' while bread proofing.
rhett: Baba O'Riley -> pairing: read a 5-page Raymond Carver story for post-dish quiet.
mina: The Crown intro -> 6-min silent film clip 'The Hand That Feeds' (imagined title) for regal mug handling. :wink:
jukebox-bot: Added 'Chef's Table Theme', 'Baba O'Riley', and 'The Crown Theme' to playlist 'kitchen-symphony-curated' https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake_kitchen_symphony
zoe: tiny poll: who should be the first "kitchen conductor" (small weekly rota to queue the playlist and light the incense): react :one: alan, :two: rhett, :three: mina
alan: :one: (i accept the solemn duty)
rhett: :two: competitive baton waving.
mina: :three: only if i can rename the incense to "dramatic simmer". :laughing:
facilities: FYI: we're scheduling a coffee machine deep clean Friday 4pm. please remove personal mugs from the top shelf by 3:45pm.
zoe: note taken. also kudos to @rhett for fixing the stereo last week  tiny hero award :trophy:
rhett: thanks! will accept in the form of biscotti. :cookie:
zoe: plan: i'll rotate the playlist today, then hand off baton to whoever's conductor next week. report back if anyone actually bows to the espresso machine. mission: make mundane feel cinematic. :sparkles:
